main.description: Score Hume image-head emotion for an ai-image (or batch all ai-images in a doc) and roll a max-saliency aggregate up to each panel that contains scored children. Writes the result to the node's `_emotion` field. Uses the distilled `visual_centroid_v1` student model when MANGAKA_HUME_STUDENT_MODEL is set, otherwise the stdlib `visual_heuristic_v1` fallback.

imageNid.description: Optional. If set, only score this one ai-image; otherwise batch all ai-images in the doc and recompute every panel aggregate.
Echo of the input imageNid (single mode)

panelEmotion.description: Batch-mode { panelNid: emotionRecord } map (JSON-encoded) — max-saliency rollup across child ai-images
